_comment: Eras mode tunables (eras build plan 1.3; eras spec sections 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8). Read through eras/config.ts, never directly. unlockShare: share of an era's stars (3 per race) needed to unlock the next era in play order; the count is ceil(unlockShare x 3 x races), so 0.7 with 10 races is 21 (spec 5, ERA_UNLOCK_SHARE). accuracyMultiplier: decisionAccuracy = max(0, 100 - accuracyMultiplier x winChanceLost), winChanceLost in percentage points (spec 6). hardCallEdge: a decision moment is a hard call when the best two options are within this many percentage points; either a BAND_EDGES key from grade.ts (default 'yellow', 5 points) or a number (spec 4, HARD_CALL_EDGE). difficulty: one row per play order (spec 7): accuracyThreshold is the star-2 race accuracy (0-100) needed; information is full | reduced | limited | minimal; rivalPolicy is standard | standard-plus | smart | expert; decisionTimerSeconds is the decision timer. legend: Legend difficulty, the hardest settings regardless of era (spec 8).
